why: The MCP tab's web-only "Get the app" door leaves the value layer's 11px chip for the primary sm standard button (`buttonVariants`), the same door the Agents and Models tabs beside it already wear. It navigates, so it stays a `<Link>`; the value layer has no standard-button shape by design, so the registry row (`AgentSetupSection.standard-button.json`) is the only honest home for it.
